role: Development-only pre-trade allocator for the first two crude-oil strategies. It arbitrates shared formal-account position and external market-turn limits without erasing strategy-book ownership.
invariants: directional and calendar-spread ordinary risk-increasing requests receive equal 50:50 entitlement under the development proxy
allocation is deterministic and independent of request-list ordering
mandatory strategy-risk reductions are considered before ordinary risk-increasing requests but can never override an exchange hard limit
calendar-spread ordinary allocation is atomic in spread units and never breaks the one-to-one Main versus Adjacent Next leg ratio
single-contract position limits apply to aggregate formal-account named-contract positions after all allocated strategy deltas
all-contract gross position cap applies to the aggregate formal-account named-contract positions
per-turn market capacity applies to the external net named-contract order after opposing strategy flows are internally netted for pre-trade purposes
internal netting changes external market footprint only and never deletes per-strategy allocated deltas or ownership
a strategy that cannot use its entitlement because one of its hard constraints binds releases unused ordinary capacity to the other eligible strategy
new-trades-disabled contracts may not receive an external order that increases aggregate absolute exposure
the allocator does not create fills, prices, pnl, cash, margin, financing, or market write-back
stress audit demand amplification is development-only and does not modify production capital or market-owner limits
